name: insert_ranked_value

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_InsertRankedValue reads table index, sort order, and value from the Script stack in that order and decrements Script stackTop by three

notes: ScriptCommand_InsertRankedValue selects one of ten five-entry arrays at offset 0xB14 in work buffer 1, finds the insertion point using descending comparisons when sort_order is 0 or ascending comparisons when it is 1, shifts lower-ranked entries down, and stores the value. Its eight JP calls insert the same timer variable into ascending tables 6 through 9 in the two Hundred Acre Wood time-trial result scripts.
